content.text: Section 18 meets every preferred element; no redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is a full Vendor insurance clause that satisfies the preferred position, not merely the fallback. Clause 18.1 requires commercial general liability of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, which more than satisfies the conditional preferred element given Vendor processes Customer Data under § 17). Clause 18.2 gives us certificates of insurance on request, and adds favourable extras (primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). No redline is warranted.
